info.flavor: In the early days of the Makaptan labor conflict, logistical issues on both sides limited the number of chassis that could be fielded at once. As a workaround, fighters would train in the perilous art of mech jockeying, enabling them to multiply force at a much lower material cost. Although advances in infrastructure have removed the need for these so-called "hitchikers", a few dauntless individuals continue to swear by the technique's effectiveness.
info.tactics: The Hitchhiker clings to an ally to passively agument its own defenses while providing support fire and interfering with nearby enemies' attacks. Its optionals can grant its partner a variety of offensive and defensive buffs. Hitchhikers function best when enabling frontliners and are less durable and effective if isolated.
info.terse: Rides on allies to augment their offense and defense.

name: Black Thumb
effect:
The Hitchhiker may initiate a ride with an adjacent allied character, or deploy already riding with any allied character. The allied character is designated as the Driver for the duration of the ride.
During a ride, the Hitchhiker gains +4 Evasion to a maximum of 20, occupies the Driver's space, and is moved with the Driver whenever they move. The ride ends when the Hitchhiker would move away from the Driver or the Driver is destroyed. Before a ride ends, the Hitchhiker first moves into a free space of the triggering character's choice adjacent to the Driver.

actions.name: Black Thumb
actions.detail: If you are not Immobilized, start a ride with an adjacent allied character.

active_effects.name: Black Thumb
active_effects.detail: While riding with an ally, you gain +4 Evasion to a maximum of 20, occupy their space, and are moved with them whenever they move.

name: "Blown Kiss" Pistol
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy when used during a reaction.

on_hit.detail: Target's next successful attack deals half damage, Burn, and Heat.

add_special.name: Weakened
add_special.detail: Your next successful attack deals half damage, Burn, and Heat.

actions.name: I'm Helping!
actions.trigger: The Driver makes a successful attack roll.
actions.detail: You attack the same target with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol.

actions.name: Slow Down, Buckaroo
actions.trigger: A character within Range 5 makes an attack roll that does not target you.
actions.detail: You interrupt the triggering character, attacking them with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol.

name: Go Get 'Em, Tiger
effect: The Driver gains the ability to Overcharge if they do not already have it. Instead of the standard cost, the Driver and all Hitchhikers riding with them take 1d3 Heat.

actions.name: On Your Six
actions.detail: You enter a state of hypervigilance. All your weapons and the Driver's weapons gain +2 Threat until the start of your next turn. If your ride ends or you become Jammed, Exposed, or Stunned, this effect ends immediately.

actions.name: This'll Patch Ya Up
actions.detail: You spray a protective coating onto the Driver. They gain +2 Armor up to a maximum of 4 until the end of your next turn or until your ride ends. You cannot take this action again until its effect ends.

add_special.detail: You gain +2 Armor up to a maximum of 4.

actions.name: That Was Too Close
actions.trigger: Either you or the Driver are targeted by a ranged attack.
actions.effect: Before the triggering attack is rolled, make an attack roll with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol. If the result is higher than the triggering attack roll, the triggering attack automatically misses. This reaction cannot be taken if it would cause you to exceed your Heat Cap.

actions.name: Get Dunked On!
actions.detail:
A character within Sensors gains the Hitchhiker's Mark. Whenever they make an attack that does not include you as a target, they must pass a Systems save afterwards or become Jammed until the end of their next turn. On a success, they become Impaired instead, but clear the Hitchhiker's Mark.
A character cannot be marked by more than one Hitchhiker at a time. You can mark only one character at a time, but can transfer the Hitchhiker's Mark to another character by repeating this action.

add_special.detail: Whenever you make an attack that does not include the Hitchhiker as a target, you must pass a Systems save afterwards or become Jammed until the end of your next turn. On a success, you become Impaired instead, but clear this mark.

name: My Lucky Day [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, during a ride, either the Hitchhiker or the Driver may roll an attack, check, or save twice and choose the higher result.

active_effects.name: My Lucky Day
active_effects.condition: You are riding with an ally and either you or they roll an attack, check, or save.
active_effects.detail: The triggering character may roll twice and choose the higher result.
